objective: Investigate whether an ordered price-volume pattern is informative about a later net +30 percent opening-price proxy. The user's goal remains a genuinely executable, very-high-probability single-position net +30 percent signal, with no fixed holding deadline.
notTheStrictCandidate: This separately named hypothesis deliberately uses unadjusted raw prices and diagnostic historical identity fallbacks. It neither supplies nor fabricates noEventsProven/bridged evidence to the frozen strict detector. It cannot certify corporate-action-adjusted economic profit or the user's goal.
priorResultsInspected: Six earlier development candidates and their path risk have been inspected. This interval is development data. No real outcomes for this sequential price candidate have been calculated before this registration.

sample.source: Same frozen local SH/SZ main-board sample as baseline
sample.initialPatternState: Idle at first development exchange session; pre-start bars provide indicator warmup but do not create a carried pattern or a 2021 signal

baseEligibility.implementation: Existing DailyScorer base eligibility on the same snapshot, configuration and day
baseEligibility.unknownIdentityFields: Retained as unverified; observed-history lower bound and local-membership fallback remain diagnostic assumptions
baseEligibility.applies: Evaluate every security every exchange session, including missing bars and ineligible states; do not prefilter before advancing a waiting pattern

pattern.rawBasis: TDX unadjusted OHLC and volume, not DailyScorer signal_bars; raw priceBasisId is a format label, not proof of comparable corporate-action regimes
pattern.breakout: At B close, require complete positive-volume 81 aligned exchange sessions; close_B > maximum high of preceding 40, close_B > MA80_B > MA80_previous, volume_B >= 1.2 times mean volume of preceding 40
pattern.freezeAtBreakout: A=prior40 maximum high, close_B, volume_B and original B calendar index; no later reanchoring while waiting
pattern.retest: First R in B+1..B+9 with A<=low_R<=1.02*A, close_R<close_B and volume_R<=0.8*volume_B; freeze first R and high_R
pattern.renewal: First T strictly after R and no later than B+10 with close_T>high_R, close_T>previous-session close, and volume_T>=volume_B
pattern.priority: On a waiting observed session low<A invalidates before retest or renewal. No same-session invalidation and reanchor. Equality at A is allowed.
pattern.deadline: Known suspensions consume the ten-session formation deadline; first R at B+10 cannot confirm. This is only a formation deadline, not a holding deadline.
pattern.knownSuspension: Only explicit historical tradeStatus indicates a halt. It cannot trigger a pattern; a positive-volume contradiction is unresolved. Without a known close at the preceding suspended session, a subsequent renewal requiring that close is unresolved.
pattern.unknownData: Missing/unobserved/invalid/strict-history-missing data or unexplained zero volume is unevaluable while idle and aborts a waiting pattern as unknown; it is not a known pattern failure
pattern.knownIneligibility: Other known failed base-eligibility conditions invalidate a waiting pattern and do not reanchor on that day
pattern.actionPolicy: No action-absence or adjusted-price comparability assertion. Corporate actions may affect both raw triggers and raw-price outcomes. Keep action/identity/execution certainty false throughout.
pattern.afterSignal: Reset pattern detector to idle after T; earliest next anchor is next exchange session. Holdings never suppress raw pattern detection.

selection.ranking: Among every completed raw sequence at T, close_T/A-1 ascending then symbol ascending; score is the negative distance solely to reuse descending-score event tooling
selection.positionExclusion: Rank and mark Top5 first; exclude still-active same-symbol same-group events afterward. No sixth-ranked replacement. An exit at today's open permits a new close signal that day.
selection.controls: Same-day base-eligible fixed-hash sample excluding that day's strategy Top5; same requested count; original control seed and cost/execution model
selection.controlLimit: Independently active-deduplicated descriptive comparison; event dates need not remain matched, no causal uplift or independent-observation claim

eventPolicy.entry: Frozen quantity from T close and volume with fee/limit reserve; one attempt at next exchange-session open, no delayed entry
eventPolicy.execution: Reuse frozen SignalTargetStudy fees, slippage, T+1 sale lock, gates and capacity proxies unchanged
eventPolicy.terminal: Observation cutoff right-censoring; no forced sale and no inference of eventual failure from an unfinished event

audit.fullCandidateLog: Every completed raw pattern with B/R/T facts and ranking, including non-Top5 and later active-suppressed candidates
audit.transitions: Every transition except idle notTriggered/unevaluable stored individually; omitted idle events counted by kind and reason for every date, with written/omitted counts reconciling to every security-session step. Waiting abortedUnknown/invalidated/expired/held never omitted.
audit.cutoff: Retain final pending pattern states and counts separately; unfinished pattern is not an entry or a failed trade
audit.files: Protocol, source snapshot, all selected signals and controls, candidates, coverage, transitions and result bound to completion hashes; corrupt completed output refuses resume
audit.attempts: Keep failed attempts; change code or rules only in a new version after any real outcome has been inspected
audit.cohort: Potential calendar followup defines mature cohorts independently of whether an early target was hit. Keep incomplete followup, missing outcomes, unfilled entries and active suppression visible.
audit.risk: Append fixed PathRiskStudy -10/-20 raw-price boundary observations without changing trades; include entry-day lows and exclude lows after target opening exit
audit.dependence: Report distinct symbols and signal dates; existing Wilson intervals assume independence and cannot support certification for overlapping events
audit.review: Verify source hashes and data fingerprint; synthetic causal and lifecycle tests plus independent code review before full run; inspect arithmetic, lineage and per-event timing after completion
